voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Every hourly report gave her height as twenty thousand feet. The Star Tiger, a British airliner, over the Atlantic, nineteen forty-eight.
The inquiry called it an error for two thousand: her planned height, below the cloud, out of the worst winds.
An hour ahead, a second airliner found the wind far stronger than forecast. It was blown more than sixty miles off course.
It landed safely. The Star Tiger, an hour behind, was never seen again.
The inquiry could not say exactly how high she was when her radio went silent.
